verses.1: The people of Tyre and Sidon, and those who dwell on the shore of the sea, and beyond the river Jordan, and Gilead, and Karan, and the Canaanites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, and Edom, and the people of Amalek.
verses.2: And all the nations in their lands, and in their provinces, and in their territories, and in their borders, and in the division of their lands. And all of them, according as the Lord has ordained them, shall pass away.
verses.3: And among them are those whose way is good, and who believe in the Lord.
verses.4: And among them are those whose deeds are evil, and who do not believe in the Lord who created them and formed them, because they served under the hand of Ameneser, king of Syria.
verses.5: For he shall take the power of Damascus, and the pride of Samaria shall be cut off before the king of Egypt.
verses.6: The mountain of Gilead, and the hill of Gelabuhe, and all Samaria, and Pathos of the land of Judah, and those who dwell in the mountain of Arabia, and Med, and Pertus, and Siusigya, and Cappadocia.
verses.7: And also those who dwell within their borders, a numerous and mighty people, who do not believe in the Lord and have not kept His commandment.
verses.8: And He shall recompense them according to the evil of their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.
verses.9: For the forces of Caesarea, and the people of Gilead, and Amalek gather together to fight against the city of God, which is full of righteousness, in which the Holy One of Israel is praised, the God of Israel, the Lord of Hosts, who sits above the chariot of the cherubim; and thousands of myriads stand before Him, and myriads of myriads serve Him with fear and trembling.
